notes.title: Space Rescue will be released at 9pm HDT
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, I am Raker, the author of this game.
Originally scheduled for release this Friday, Space Rescue will be released as a free-to-play game at 9pm HDT today.

If you encounter any problems with the game or have any comments or suggestions about the game itself, please contact me in the community or by email~

meiyisi1314o@gmail.com 📫

I look forward to your feedback, and I wish you all a lot of fun~
